methodology.scope: Every primary FR/ES/IT/PT/RU form in the listed lexical inputs and every SMARTool Russian lemma received reproducible structural, script, register, qualifier, POS-risk and same-language frequency-alternative screening.
methodology.semanticReview: Exact replacement cases and qualified/notation-risk records were inspected individually by the app's AI-assisted editorial reviewer. This is not independent native-speaker verification of every word or sense.
methodology.secondPass: Remaining frequency-prioritized candidates were inspected for concrete meaning, POS and English-explanatory-prose defects. Additional exact corrections carry a reviewNote explaining the specific error. Frequency gaps themselves are not errors and remaining candidates are not automatically changed.
methodology.frequency: Pinned native-language subtitle token ranks only prioritize source alternatives for review. No automatic substitution by rank, no shortening of correct phrases to frequent generic words, and no CEFR assignment.
methodology.provenance: Source-attested alternatives remain attributable to their source. Cleaned source notation is identified separately. New translations and spelling corrections are explicitly app-authored editorial adaptations.
methodology.limits: Unflagged means no screened condition fired, not semantically verified. Qualified equivalences, regional variants and grammatical category differences can be legitimate. No rare form is removed solely because it is absent from a corpus. Remaining candidates are explicitly unresolved.
methodology.display: All replacement text is a standalone word/phrase with no explanatory parentheses. Source evidence and grammar remain metadata.
notCovered: New target-language dictionary-entry lookup for every form

nativeRankMethodology: Exact NFC/casefold matches for every encountered primary and alternative form, plus reviewed replacements, to this target language's pinned FrequencyWords 50k token list. Russian combining stress accents are removed; ё/й remain distinct. Original one-based ranks are retained. Missing forms and phrases are absent, never assigned invented ranks. These ranks are one possible downstream feature, not a CEFR classification or semantic judgement.
